title: US Commerce Secretary Gina Raimondo to Visit China Next Week
title_hi: अमेरिकी वाणिज्य सचिव जीना रायमोंडो अगले सप्ताह चीन का दौरा करेंगी
details: U.S. Commerce Secretary Gina Raimondo is scheduled to visit China from August 27 to 30, aiming to stabilize the world's two largest economies and manage competition, according to the Commerce Department. The visit comes amid ongoing tensions between the two nations and follows previous trips by other high-ranking U.S. officials, including Secretary of State Antony Blinken and Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen.
hook: क्या यह मुलाक़ात दुनिया की दो बड़ी ताकतों के बीच तनाव कम कर पाएगी?
